findings.text: The non-blocking-after-acknowledgement early return leaves the stop digest in place, so a duty the coordinator acknowledged and whose deferral has since expired re-enters the list with the same (kind, run_id) and reads as the set already refused, and the stop never blocks for it again; this contradicts reapply_acknowledgements' own documented contract at lines 1557-1559 ('the duty returns to the list and the stop blocks again') and lets one acknowledgement silence a duty permanently.

item_verdicts.diff: Read all three commits against base b30f1e13: 707cf54b20 adds the stop digest guard, b63bd77c37 formats the new test cases, c6dba3af65 adds the evidence fragment; 168 insertions and 22 deletions over three files.
item_verdicts.done_when: The plan's done_when asks for a test that shows the list through the prompt path then runs three stops over a growing overdue figure; tests/test_coordinator_obligations_hook.py:974 does exactly that and asserts one block, plus a gained duty that blocks again, and the manifest records both arms.
item_verdicts.goal: The node's goal is that the Stop hook blocks once per unchanged duty list; reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:1697-1707 records a digest of the blocking rows in a stop-mode file and returns silently when the same (kind, run_id) set is read again.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; status complete, both arms carry revision/command/log path and a completed flag, and the one head failure is the same failure recorded at base.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The node declared reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py, reckon/crew/obligations.py, tests/, the landing fragment and the figures directory; the diff touches only the hook, the test file and the fragment, all inside them.

justifications.durability: The done-when test reddens at base with three blocks, but no assertion covers the acknowledgement-expiry path at reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:1694-1696, where the recorded digest silences a duty whose deferral has expired.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_coordinator_obligations_hook.py:974 drives the prompt path then three stops while the manifest is backdated and asserts exactly one block, and after-arm.log records '1 failed, 95 passed' with a terminal EXIT=1.
justifications.fit: The added names _STOP_DIGEST_SUFFIX and stop_digest_path extend the existing digest_path idiom at reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:512-533 and carry no plan, stage or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py:1703-1707 compares the (kind, run_id) digest of the blocking rows against the stop mode's own record and returns 0 when the set is unchanged.
justifications.reuse: The change reuses duty_digest, _read_digest, _write_digest and _clear_digest in reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py rather than adding a second digest mechanism; no other module under reckon/ owns a last-blocked duty set.
justifications.scope_discipline: All three changed paths -- reckon/hooks/coordinator_obligations.py, tests/test_coordinator_obligations_hook.py and docs/evidence/fragments/crew-observability-truth/the-stop-hook-blocks-once-per-unchanged-duty-list.html -- are inside the node's declared write paths.
